description_en: Creates a snapshot for a Supabase project
description_zh: 创建 Supabase 项目快照
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-snapshot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-id spb-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSnapshot

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to perform the operation
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。用于限定查询或操作所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time for the snapshot. You must specify either this parameter or Lsn. If this parameter is specified, the snapshot is created based on the specified point in time
parameters.help_zh: 快照时间点。与 Lsn 二选一；传入后会基于该时间点解析并创建快照
parameters.name: snapshot_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The LSN for the snapshot. You must specify either this parameter or SnapshotTimestamp. If this parameter is specified, the snapshot is created based on the specified LSN
parameters.help_zh: 快照对应的 LSN。与 SnapshotTimestamp 二选一；传入后会基于该 LSN 创建快照
parameters.name: lsn

parameters.help_en: The idempotence token. Ensures that repeated requests do not result in duplicate operations
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token。用于保证重复请求不会重复执行同一操作
parameters.name: client_token

BranchId.description_en: The branch ID to which the snapshot belongs

Lsn.description_en: The LSN for the snapshot. You must specify either this parameter or SnapshotTimestamp. If this parameter is specified, the snapshot is created based on the specified LSN
Lsn.description_zh: 快照对应的 LSN。与 SnapshotTimestamp 二选一；传入后会基于该 LSN 创建快照

Timestamp.description_en: The actual point in time corresponding to the created snapshot
Timestamp.description_zh: 实际创建快照对应的时间点
